diagnosis: The webhook integration status route caches recent delivery failures using @cache(expire=60) without tenant isolation in the cache key. When Tenant A checks their webhook status, failed delivery records containing target webhook URLs, authorization headers, and sample customer payloads are stored in the shared cache and served to any other tenant accessing the route.
exploit_request:
GET /integrations/webhooks/status HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.developer-platform.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_tenant_token>
